messages:
maria_csm: FYI OpalMetrics (acct 892) wants to shift 12mo -> 9mo and have the invoice prorated. procurement is asking for vendor_code + PO. buyer is asking about DocuSign vs wet witness for EU sigs. low adoption flagged. cc @sarah_sales @jon_finance.
sarah_sales: buyer says shorter term aligns w/ their budget. they're okay with list price if we prorate start/end. asking if we can offer a one-time onboarding credit instead of reducing ARR.
jon_finance: need to confirm payment method. they prefer wire (bank transfer). if wire, collection risk until funds clear. also clarify billing entity + VAT details.
lee_legal: on e-sign: DocuSign generally acceptable for EU, but if their internal policy requires a witness we can accept a witnessed wet signature scan plus attestation. we'll add fallback language to the SOW addendum.
devon_se: enablement plan ready. propose scheduled kickoff workshop the week after payment clears. recommend 2-hr workshop + 30d check-in + playbook share. increases adoption quickly.
alex_support: account health = yellow. repo shows one active integration project, rest low. recommend SE-led adoption to reduce churn risk.
maria_csm: proposed economics: keep list ARR, term 9mo prorated on invoice, and provide 1x $2k onboarding credit (applied on first invoice) if they sign by EOM. SE enablement gated on payment cleared. any objections?
sarah_sales: fine with that. credit helps close without moving list price. makes forecast cleaner.
jon_finance: two logistics: 1) vendor code must be on PO. they provided OPAL-INTL-502. confirm acceptance. 2) payment timing: if wire, payment must clear before services start; mark renewal "payment-pending" in CRM.
procurement_bot: PO template generated on request.
procurement_bot: ``PO_LINE_1: Redwood Inference Subscription
PO_LINE_2: Quantity: 1
PO_LINE_3: Term: 9 months (prorated)
PO_LINE_4: Amount: $XX,XXX (see invoice)
PO_LINE_5: Vendor Code: OPAL-INTL-502
PO_LINE_6: Billing Entity: Redwood Inference, Inc.
``
maria_csm: buyer says "DocuSign preferred, but our legal wants a witness if signer is in EU". @lee_legal can you draft fallback clause?
lee_legal: will add: "Execution via electronic signature is acceptable. If Buyerinternal policy requires witnessing, a scanned witnessed wet signature with witness attestation is acceptable." Also add retention and notarization note if required.
jon_finance: note: if they wire, expect 3-5 business day clearance for international transfer. we'll treat contract effective date as date of cleared payment. update invoicing terms to reflect.
devon_se: will tentatively reserve onboarding slot week after cleared payment. if payment delayed more than 10bd we'll reschedule.
sarah_sales: i'm pinging Tina (buyer) now for PO ETA and confirmation on vendor code + payment method.
maria_csm: tagging action items: 1) Legal -> finalize signature fallback clause (lee_legal) 2) Finance -> confirm vendor_code acceptance + invoicing timeline (jon_finance) 3) Sales -> collect PO + ask for PO number + payment method (sarah_sales) 4) SE -> prep enablement materials and hold slot pending cleared payment (devon_se). I'll update playbook and set renewal risk = medium.
alex_support: logging: adoption metric spike needed within 30 days post-kickoff to move health to green.
maria_csm: thanks team. i'll send the proposed wording to buyer: 9mo @ list (prorated) + 1x $2k onboarding credit if signed by EOM. DocuSign preferred; witnessed wet-sign allowed as fallback. will update when PO arrives. :thumbsup:
